rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for food that has a pleasant or satisfying flavor.

example.english: The baked pork chop at this café is tasty.
example.traditional: 呢間茶記啲焗豬扒好食。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 caa4 gei3 di1 guk6 zyu1 paa4 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use this for an enthusiastic, broadly positive reaction to food or something appealing, rather than a literal flavor description.

example.english: This ice cream is really tasty!
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 syut3 gou1 zan1 hai6 zing3

rows.note: Use this specifically when a person is sexually attractive, not for food or an appealing song.

example.jyutping: go2 go3 neoi5 zai2 zan1 hai6 hou2 sok3
